name: EQ
description: A track EQ (D84): a Butterworth high-pass (low cut), an optional low-pass (high cut), a low shelf, a peak and a high shelf. Heard in the preview (Web Audio biquads) and the export (ffmpeg highpass/lowshelf/equalizer/highshelf/lowpass) with the same Audio EQ Cookbook curves. A band at 0 dB is off.
author: Uncut

lowCutHz.description: High-pass (low cut) corner in Hz, 12 dB/octave Butterworth; absent = off. Used within 20–1000 (values outside are clamped, as projects from before v0.2 may have them).

highCutHz.description: Low-pass (high cut) corner in Hz, 12 dB/octave Butterworth; absent = off. Used within 1000–20000 (clamped).

bands.description: Deprecated (v0.1, never drawn): kept so older projects open; ignored.
